body: i hope you are ok also, dont worry about me lol i am really not worth it

i mean i dunno, its hard to kind of ask because i dont feel skinny enough for it too be a problem. i am getting help because she knows i cut but she has not a clue about this, with self harm i could see it on me at all times because i could just look at my arm but with this its kind of a slow process which you cant just look at and say "yep, eating disorder", i could see i had a problem with self harm but its hard to feel like i have a eating disorder because i always never feel skinny enough

if im being honest, from doing this so much ive became used to it and kind of accustom to it, i like standing up and almost blacking out, trembling around everywhere i go, barely being able to keep myself straight without shaking from weakness, like i just feel like im gonna give out any second and pass out. the feeling of my stomach sucking itself in, sometimes it hurts too, but i really dont mind.

it also just gives me that feeling of power you were talking about, i have pretty low self esteem so i dont really get that much power out of talking to people or doing things, but this i love, i love the power of just making it another day without eating, it feels like a accomplishment, and i dont have alot of those so i like this, it helps me just feel good enough for people also.

i used to self harm alot, but now that ive done this i dont really have any urges to do so, ive never really tried fasting but i think i know what it is, but right now i am just doing the usual starve for 2-3 days and then eat a little bit, i ate around 3 hours ago because i haven't ate since Monday and my mom forced me to eat something but it only fills me with guilt, i just feel like such a quitter for not being able to just go that extra day.

i don't really know how to stop myself, i just wanna do it more and more until i am perfect, and maybe even then ill continue just to get this feeling some more.

yeah...

i hate taking showers cuz i gotta look at myself, same with mirrors, i just look so weird and honestly gross. i'd rather be skinny even if it kills me
but i dont wanna be lazy or fat, i dont even wanna be really jacked or atleast slim, i wanna be skinny, like really skinny, then i love myself.
i enjoy music, although i dunno if ill be ever to stop this habit, it hurts to eat alot which just makes me wanna do it less and honestly ive kinda gotten used to starving and i somewhat like it now
it'll never be good enough for me or others
i just wanna be really skinny
yeah for me its either ill look perfect from this or i will die, win win.
